personal.aboutText: I am a Full-Stack and Mobile Developer based in Surabaya, Indonesia. With over 3 years of hands-on experience in building scalable web applications and high-performance mobile apps, I enjoy solving complex problems and turning ideas into responsive digital solutions. I am constantly learning new technologies and improving my skills to deliver state-of-the-art products.

bullets: Lead the design, development, and maintenance of internal applications, including the Logistic Management System (LMS), optimizing operational efficiency.
Developed and managed mobile applications (iOS & Android) for logistics operations using Laravel, Vue, Node.js, and Flutter, enhancing functionality and user engagement.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure a reliable and scalable application infrastructure, resulting in a 30% reduction in operational delays.
Designed and maintained responsive websites and applications, working with technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Developed front-end and back-end functionalities using frameworks like Node, React, Vue, Flutter, and Laravel, achieving faster and more efficient project deployment.
Enhanced application responsiveness and user interface, ensuring a positive and seamless user experience.
Assisted in the development and maintenance of applications to meet user preferences, utilizing Laravel and Vue.js.
Supported the implementation of user-centered features, improving overall application satisfaction and usability for clients.
